GlassPanel with: tags row (CategoryBadge + Badge variant size=sm {t(badge.label)}); name (semibold, truncate->numberOfLines 1); description (muted, line-clamp-2->numberOfLines 2); when derivedStatus!=='completed' a progress section (`${fmtNumber(pct,0)}%` + Due label) + ProgressBar; footer mileage (Gauge->speed icon, `${fmtNumber(current_mileage,0)} ${t('mi')}` when >0) and last_service_date (Clock icon, formatDate). Adaptations summary: no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported — only React Native primitives + the shared native components (AppText/GlassPanel/EmptyState/SemanticIcon), native theme tokens, the native web-parity api client + useSettings/useVehicles hooks and the CONVERTED AIPredictiveMaintenance. State names (vehicleId/setVehicleId, items/records, loadingItems/loadingRecords, itemsError/recordsError, categoryFilter/sortBy, categories/categoryOptions/sortOptions, filteredItems, summary, serviceColumns, costStats, projections, handleSchedule, anyError, isLoading), both API paths (/maintenance, /maintenance/records), the query keys (['maintenance',vehicleId] / ['service-records',vehicleId]), the snake_case shapes, the deterministic helpers (computeProgress/statusFromPct/progressBarColor/categoryColors/sortItems), and the section order are all preserved. Mileage is rendered verbatim with the 'mi' label (the web source performs no SI conversion here).
